description_for_human: Sovereign AI platform for autonomous counter-UAS defense of critical infrastructure
description_for_model: QLUU Lab builds QLUUos, an edge-deployed, air-gapped AI operating system for autonomous counter-drone defense. The platform detects, tracks, classifies, and neutralizes unauthorized drone threats in real time. QLUUos features a Commander World Model for predictive threat trajectory modeling, a War Planner Agent for sub-320ms autonomous course-of-action generation, and swarm coordination for multi-platform intercept operations. The company also designs custom autonomous platforms: Cyclops UAV interceptor, Sentinel UGV perimeter sentry, and Command-Hive One mobile mothership. Key specs: 92% intercept accuracy, 1.2s detection-to-track, Level 4 autonomy. Compatible with MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot. California-based, US-owned.
